hero.heading: Shopify analytics that actually works
hero.subheading: Most analytics tools break on Shopify: cookie consent blocks tracking, GA4 loses attribution, and Shopify's built-in reports cannot answer the questions that matter. OpenPanel tracks every event without cookies, so your data is complete and the checkout keeps its conversion rate.

problem.title: Why analytics breaks on Shopify
problem.intro: Every major analytics tool creates a different problem for Shopify stores. Here's what you're actually dealing with.

items.title: GA4 consent mode destroys your data
items.description: Cookie consent requirements mean 30-50% of visitors opt out. GA4's "consent mode" fills gaps with modeled data, you're making decisions on estimates, not reality.

items.title: Shopify's built-in analytics is shallow
items.description: Pageviews and sales are there, but you can't build funnels, analyze drop-off by product page, or see which acquisition channel retains customers best.

items.title: Event tracking requires a developer
items.description: Installing GA4 on Shopify correctly, with purchase events, add-to-cart, and checkout steps, requires custom code or expensive third-party apps.

items.title: Cookie banners hurt conversion
items.description: A consent popup before checkout is a conversion killer. Every analytics tool that uses cookies forces you to choose between data and revenue.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions from Shopify store owners evaluating OpenPanel.

items.question: How do I install OpenPanel on Shopify?
items.answer: Add the OpenPanel script tag via Shopify Admin, Online Store, Themes, Edit code, theme.liquid, before </head>. Page views track immediately. For purchases, enable client-side revenue in your project settings and call op.revenue(amount, { orderId }) on the order confirmation page.

items.question: Does OpenPanel work without a cookie consent banner?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel sets no cookies and stores no raw IP, so no consent banner is required under GDPR or CCPA for analytics-only use.

items.question: Can I track Shopify purchase events?
items.answer: Yes. A few lines on the order confirmation page send the order total, order id and products to OpenPanel as a revenue event. Enable client-side revenue in project settings first, or send it from your backend with the client secret. No Shopify app required.

items.question: How does OpenPanel compare to Lucky Orange or Hotjar for Shopify?
items.answer: Lucky Orange and Hotjar are built around heatmaps and recordings. OpenPanel has session replay too, next to the events, funnels and retention that explain what users do, but no heatmaps. If heatmaps matter to you, the tools complement each other.

items.question: Will OpenPanel affect my Shopify store's page speed?
items.answer: The tracker is about 3 KB gzipped and loads async, one of the lightest available; GA4 is many times larger. The performance impact is negligible.

items.question: Does OpenPanel work with Shopify Plus?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel works on any Shopify plan including Plus. The script tag installation method works identically across all plans.
